```bash
flutter pub add stellar_wallet_flutter_sdk stellar_flutter_sdk
```

This adds both packages to your `pubspec.yaml` at versions that resolve together, for example:

```yaml
# pubspec.yaml
dependencies:
  stellar_wallet_flutter_sdk: ^1.1.6
  stellar_flutter_sdk: ^3.8.0
```

The wallet SDK depends on `stellar_flutter_sdk`, the base [Flutter Stellar SDK](https://github.com/Soneso/stellar_flutter_sdk), so you could leave it out and get it as a transitive dependency. The later examples in this tutorial import it directly, so add it as well. Let `pub add` choose the version pair instead of copying version numbers from another guide: each wallet SDK release requires a minimum version of the base SDK, and a stale pair makes pub fall back to an old wallet SDK release.

Check the current versions on [pub.dev](https://pub.dev/packages/stellar_wallet_flutter_sdk) or the [project GitHub page](https://github.com/Soneso/stellar_wallet_flutter_sdk).
